group.name: Electroad
group.description:
Imagine never having to stop at a gas station or waiting hours while your electric car battery is been charged. Instead, you will simply drive your electric vehicle while your battery maintains its charge.
Now stop imagining. It’s already here.
 
Dynamic Wireless Electrification System for electric transportation. A revolutionary technology that reduces the need for a large battery in the vehicle and powers it wirelessly via a minimal infrastructure located under the driving lane.
 
The potential of electric roads is enormous. Our initial focus is public transportation, however, the possible uses are endless. We aim to continue with car-sharing vehicles, taxis, and distribution trucks. Finally, we intend to penetrate the entire transportation market.
